name: clock-travel-west
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile across a trip three hours west: the pump's clock starts three hours ahead of the phone's and is set three hours back on its screen 180 minutes ago, so it ends on the phone's time. Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that ends after the change; after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago, so the records either side of the change are stamped on different clocks.
